grouping_convention: OBTC01 declared twelve gate conditions: ten evaluated PER ARM and two evaluated ACROSS ARMS, because a single arm cannot exhibit either domain-size invariance or the response to removing the source. T07 certifies the ten; T08 certifies the two.
